# Chike's Creative Space

> Chike's Creative Space turns imagination into action: hands-on activities, games, stories, and short animated adventures, for kids and the grown-ups doing them alongside.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.chikescreativespace.com/): The starting point - jump into Create, Play, Watch, or Read from here.
- [Create](https://www.chikescreativespace.com/create): Hands-on activities and projects, filterable by age, type, or material.
- [Read](https://www.chikescreativespace.com/stories): A library of picture books, browsable by character or search.
- [Watch](https://www.chikescreativespace.com/watch): Animated episodes, each one linked back to a matching activity.
- [Play](https://www.chikescreativespace.com/play): Online games and offline, unplug-and-play games.
- [Meet Chike](https://www.chikescreativespace.com/characters): The cast of characters, each with their own creative focus.
- [Grown-Ups](https://www.chikescreativespace.com/grown-ups): Answers for parents and teachers on ages, materials, safety, and classroom use.
- [About us](https://www.chikescreativespace.com/about/team): Who runs Chike's Creative Space, and how to reach the team.
- [Shop](https://www.chikescreativespace.com/shop): Books made by Chike's Creative Space, plus supplies its activities use.
